meta.name: nuclear-review
meta.description: Extremely strict whole-codebase maintainability audit — checks structural quality, 1k-line file sprawl, thin wrappers, leaked logic, spaghetti growth, and dependency freshness + usage quality via context7. Pushes "code-judo" moves that delete whole branches instead of rearranging them. When fixes land, the same pass updates CHANGELOG, MANUAL, and derived schemas so the docs don't drift. Triggers "nuclear review", "thermonuclear review", "thermo-nuclear code quality review", "code judo", "deep code quality audit", "harsh maintainability review", "whole codebase review". Sibling to `/review` (per-diff Darkroom checklist) and `/zero-tech-debt` (rework patch to end-state).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深度审查代码库结构，消除坏味道和冗余
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护大型代码库时担心质量和可维护性
copy.tagline_en: Audit codebase structure deeply and eliminate bad smells
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a large codebase and care about quality and maintainability

howto.what: 装上该技能后，Claude会对整个代码库进行极其严格的可维护性审计。它会检查文件结构、大文件、薄包装、泄露的逻辑和意大利面条式增长，并优先通过删除整个分支而非重组来简化代码。当修复应用后，它会自动更新CHANGELOG、MANUAL和派生模式。
howto.when: 当你提到 'nuclear review'、'code judo' 或 'whole codebase review' 等关键词时触发。它常用于主要版本发布之后、长时间冲刺之后或代码库变得沉重时。

say.text: 对整个代码库进行核审查。
say.note: Claude启动全面审计，检查结构质量和依赖状况。

say.text: 执行code judo操作，删除不必要的分支。
say.note: 它会寻找可以大幅简化代码的重构机会。

say.text: 更新CHANGELOG和MANUAL以反映最近的改动。
say.note: 在修复后更新文档，确保同步。

howto.what_en: Claude performs an extremely strict whole-codebase maintainability audit. It checks file structure, large files, thin wrappers, leaked logic, and spaghetti growth, and prioritizes deleting entire branches over rearranging. After applying fixes, it updates CHANGELOG, MANUAL, and derived schemas.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'nuclear review', 'code judo', or 'whole codebase review'. Also used after major version cuts, extended velocity sprints, or when the codebase feels heavy.

say_en.text: Run a nuclear review on the entire codebase.
say_en.note: Claude starts a comprehensive maintainability audit.

say_en.text: Perform code judo to delete unnecessary branches.
say_en.note: Claude looks for simplifications that remove whole parts of the code.

say_en.text: Update CHANGELOG and MANUAL after fixes.
say_en.note: Claude updates documentation to reflect changes.
